messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nUsers cannot see how reserves and payments integrate with their accounting tools or update in real time with supplier changes. This makes it hard to trust financial data and plan accurately.\n\n## Who is affected\n- At least two accounts, including the prospect Sallowmere Motor, have asked about seeing how reserves and payments sync with their existing accounting tools [i:26e61b44eb162f19].\n- At least two accounts, including the customer Marrowgate Commercial, have expressed a need to see how reserves and payments sync with supplier updates in real time [i:39d4d6cef8757f3e].\n\n## Evidence\n- The opportunity is based on 2 accounts [i:26e61b44eb162f19][i:39d4d6cef8757f3e].\n- There are 2 total mentions of this problem [i:26e61b44eb162f19][i:39d4d6cef8757f3e].\n- The mentions come from 1 route: sales [i:26e61b44eb162f19][i:39d4d6cef8757f3e].\n- The total ARR from the accounts in the fact sheet is £1,600,000 [i:39d4d6cef8757f3e].\n- There has been 1 renewal in the last 90 days [i:39d4d6cef8757f3e].\n- A prospect, Sallowmere Motor, said, \"That sounds promising. Can we see how reserves and payments sync with our existing accounting tools?\" [i:26e61b44eb162f19].\n- A customer, Marrowgate Commercial, said, \"Yes, that’d be helpful — especially if we can see how reserves and payments sync with supplier updates in real time.\" [i:39d4d6cef8757f3e].\n\n## Why now\n- The customer Marrowgate Commercial, which has an ARR of £1,600,000, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12 [i:39d4d6cef8757f3e].\n- The problem was mentioned by both a prospect and a customer in October 2026 [i:26e61b44eb162f19][i:39d4d6cef8757f3e].\n- The fact sheet is current as of 2026-11-03, placing these recent mentions just before this date [i:26e61b44eb162f19][i:39d4d6cef8757f3e].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "26e61b44eb162f19",
   "quote": "That sounds promising. Can we see how reserves and payments sync with our existing accounting tools?",
   "account": "Sallowmere Motor",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-18T10:32:00Z"
  },
  {
   "id": "39d4d6cef8757f3e",
   "quote": "Yes, that’d be helpful — especially if we can see how reserves and payments sync with supplier updates in real time.",
   "account": "Marrowgate Commercial",

 ],

   "sales": 2
  },

   {
    "name": "Sallowmere Motor",

   {
    "name": "Marrowgate Commercial",
    "arr_gbp": 1600000.0,

 }
}

<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>

</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the 'Who is affected' claims. The brief states 'At least two accounts, including the prospect Sallowmere Motor, have asked about seeing how reserves and payments sync with their existing accounting tools [i:26e61b44eb162f19],' but only Sallowmere Motor's cited quote mentions accounting tools — Marrowgate Commercial's quote is about supplier updates, not accounting tools. Similarly, the brief claims 'At least two accounts, including the customer Marrowgate Commercial, have expressed a need to see how reserves and payments sync with supplier updates in real time [i:39d4d6cef8757f3e],' but only Marrowgate Commercial's cited quote mentions supplier updates. Each claim cites a single account yet asserts 'at least two accounts,' overstating the scope beyond the cited evidence. All other claims (accounts_n, mentions_n, routes_n, ARR, renewals, quotes, dates) match the fact sheet and cited insights.", "verdict": "fail"}
